meta.title: Japanese Gojuon Learning Website
meta.description: Interactive Japanese Gojuon(50 Sounds) learning platform. Practice Hiragana, Katakana, Dakuten, Handakuten, and Yoon. Supports mouse, touch, and stylus writing. Features AI recognition. Deepen learning with listening exercises.
meta.keywords: Japanese Gojuon, Hiragana, Katakana, 50 Sounds, Japanese Learning, Japanese Pronunciation, Handwriting Practice, AI Recognition, Dakuten, Handakuten, Yoon, Japanese Teaching, Online Learning, Stylus

meta1.title: Handwriting Practice | Japanese Gojuon Learning Website
meta1.description: Use writing or a stylus, along with Japanese pronunciation, to practice handwriting the hiragana, katakana, voiced sounds (dakuon), semi-voiced sounds (handakuon), and contracted sounds (yōon) of the Japanese 50 sounds (gojūon).
meta1.keywords: Gojūon, gojūon learning, gojūon practice, hiragana, katakana, dakuon, handakuon, yōon

meta2.title: Listening Practice | Japanese Gojuon Learning Website
meta2.description: Use writing or a stylus, along with Japanese pronunciation, to practice listening the hiragana, katakana, voiced sounds (dakuon), semi-voiced sounds (handakuon), and contracted sounds (yōon) of the Japanese 50 sounds (gojūon).
meta2.keywords: Gojūon, gojūon learning, gojūon practice, hiragana, katakana, dakuon, handakuon, yōon
